title: The luminous efficacy Kcd is fixed at 683 lm/W
summary: BIPM's seventh defining constant is the luminous efficacy of monochromatic radiation at 540 × 10¹² Hz.
body: BIPM's defining-constants table gives Kcd, the luminous efficacy of monochromatic radiation of frequency 540 × 10¹² Hz, as 683 lm W⁻¹, with no uncertainty. The candela is the base unit of luminous intensity. This card reports that fixed value. It does not describe a photometric experiment.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI): Defining constants
sources.author: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures
sources.note: Page opened 2026-11-18. BIPM dates the fixed values to the revision that took effect on 20 May 2019 and cites CGPM Resolution 1 (2018).
